issues.description: Math_unary registration only executes when sys.version_info >= 3.11, breaking exp/sqrt/etc on older Pythons
issues.detail: The blank line between the Math_unary class body and the next decorated class was removed, and the `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` line now sits where the blank separator was. This is fine syntactically, but visually the entire Math_unary class header decorators previously above still apply only to Math_unary. Verify the original `@infer_global(...)` list above Math_unary still includes all the existing functions; the diff context shows registration is unchanged, but reviewers should confirm nothing was dropped.

issues.description: Missing newline at end of release note file
issues.detail: docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. Most projects' lint/CI and towncrier-style fragment processors expect trailing newlines; add one to avoid concatenation issues with the next fragment during release notes assembly.

issues.description: Inconsistent Python version gating mechanism between modules
issues.detail: test_mathlib.py uses `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION` while mathdecl.py and both mathimpl.py files use `sys.version_info` directly. Numba already exposes PYVERSION as the canonical check; using sys.version_info in core modules is inconsistent with the project's convention and harder to grep/maintain. Use PYVERSION uniformly.

issues.description: exp2_impl assigned but unused at module scope; may be flagged by linters and is dead style
issues.detail: `exp2_impl = unary_math_intr(math.exp2, 'llvm.exp2')` mirrors `exp_impl`, but neither variable is referenced elsewhere — the registration side effect inside `unary_math_intr` is what matters. That's fine for parity, but worth confirming `unary_math_intr` actually registers globally (not just returns); otherwise the conditional registration won't take effect when exp2 is called.

issues.description: Test x_values list has duplicate -2 and 2 and no edge cases like 0, inf, nan, or large negatives
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` is copy-pasted from test_exp with duplicates. For exp2 specifically, consider adding 0 (==1), a large positive (overflow behavior), and a negative fractional value to cover branch behavior of llvm.exp2 vs CPython's math.exp2.

issues.description: Release note title underline length matches the title but is brittle
issues.detail: RST headings require the underline to be at least as long as the title text. `Add support for ``math.exp2``.` plus the hyphen rule should be checked under towncrier rendering. Also the `.` at end of heading is unusual; most numba release notes phrase as a noun phrase without trailing period.

review.summary: The PR cleanly mirrors existing math.exp plumbing for math.exp2 across docs, typing, cpython/np implementations, and tests, gated on Python 3.11+. Main concerns are stylistic consistency (sys.version_info vs PYVERSION), missing trailing newline in the release note fragment, and a copy-pasted test value set that doesn't exercise interesting edge cases for exp2. No correctness blockers, but the gating mechanism should be standardized on PYVERSION before merge to keep the codebase consistent.
